title: In-Place Home Resale Re-Inspection Section Surcharge
content:
**Tariff note — section surcharge.** A coming re-inspection on an In-Place Home Resale file carries a section surcharge, added into the visit-fee sum for that visit. The section surcharge follows the home recorded on the seller's Home-Site Lease: a multi-section home adds 30.00, a single-section home of 70 feet or longer adds 15.00, and a shorter single-section home adds nothing.

| Home on the Home-Site Lease | Length | Section surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| multi-section | any length | 30.00 |
| single-section | 70 feet or longer | 15.00 |
| single-section | under 70 feet | 0.00 |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical homes).** A single-section home of 70 feet adds 15.00; one of 68 feet adds nothing; a multi-section home of 52 feet adds 30.00, the length mattering only for single-section homes.
